_help: The coding brain for VULPHEX's 3 coder bots (FOX AUDITOR / FOX FORGE / FOX REAPER): Claude Code's body (tools). DEFAULT = plain Claude: base_url and model BLANK, so it uses whatever `claude` is logged into (Mark's connected Claude). To use a different/uncensored brain instead, fill base_url + model (e.g. a Kaggle tunnel or a local Ollama Anthropic endpoint); the token is then read from env ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or VULPHEX_BRAIN_TOKEN, never stored here.
